source_refs.note: Topic 1.8.7 Online and Offline Computing Platforms (PDF 30, printed 27).

blocks.text: These platforms provide environments where developers can write, run, and test their code.

items: Online Platforms: Cloud-based platforms accessible via the internet (e.g., Repl.it, Gitpod).
Offline Platforms: Local development environments on a computer (e.g., local installations of IDEs).
